topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: I can't believe this. Just when I thought I found a stable place to live, they decide to flip everything and turn the building into condos. Of course, they expect us to buy our own units or move out—like we had any say in this. Now I have to sift through the endless listings, trying to find another apartment that won’t break the bank. Meanwhile, they’re painting this as some great opportunity. Opportunity for who, exactly? Not for those of us who were just trying to have a little peace and quiet. Looks like I get to add “stress” to my to-do list, right alongside packing and unpacking again.
